characters.name: Rafa
characters.lockedDescription: Rafa, an adult Latino man in his early fifties, salt-and-pepper hair, soft brown eyes, a neat moustache, cream knit polo and brown trousers; affectionate, thoughtful, a little puzzled but never foolish.

characters.name: Teresa
characters.lockedDescription: Teresa, an adult Latina woman in her late forties, dark shoulder-length hair, sage-green blouse and simple gold earrings; warm, observant and gently reassuring, her humor affectionate and restrained.

characters.name: Interpreter
characters.lockedDescription: A professional adult Latina interpreter in her forties, dark hair neatly tied back, midnight-blue tailored jacket over an ivory blouse; calm, attentive, visually distinct from Teresa and accurately conveys the conversation.

characters.name: Clinician
characters.lockedDescription: An adult health-care professional in their fifties with short dark hair, muted teal scrubs under a light jacket; attentive and respectful, speaking with the interpreter at eye level, no invented medical information.

groupRules.timing: Guide only; recut to the supplied song after listening.
groupRules.safety: Do not show or invent a dose, regimen, medical instruction, legible prescription, pills being taken, or a clinical answer. The misunderstanding concerns words; the answer comes from the healthcare team through a professional interpreter.
groupRules.text: Add exact Spanish copy in post, not in generated images; no generated text or numerical instruction.
